  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: inf = 1e9
  integer :: n, a(18) = 0, b(18) = 0, i, j, k, x, y, u, v
  integer, allocatable :: dp(:,:)
  read(*,*) n
  read(*,*) a(1:n)
  read(*,*) b(1:n)
  u = lshift(1,n)-1
  allocate(dp(0:u,0:50))
  dp = inf
  dp(0,0) = 0
  do k = 0, u
    do i = 1, 50
      dp(k,i) = min(dp(k,i),dp(k,i-1))
    end do
    x = popcnt(k)
    do i = 1, n
      if (btest(k,i-1)) cycle
      if (modulo(x-i+1,2) == 1) then

      else

      end if
      y = popcnt(rshift(k,i-1))
      j = ibset(k,i-1)

    end do
  end do

  if (x == inf) x = -1
  write(*,'(i0)') x

module mod_fenwick_tree
  implicit none
  type t_fenwick_tree
    private
    integer :: n, p
    integer, pointer :: arr(:) => null()
  contains
    procedure :: init => init_bit
    procedure :: release => release_bit
    procedure :: add => get_addition
    procedure :: sum => get_summation
    procedure :: range => get_partial_summation
    procedure :: val => get_value
    procedure :: lower_bound => get_lower_bound
    procedure :: update => get_updated
    procedure :: max => get_maximum
  end type
contains
  subroutine init_bit(this,n)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    integer :: p
    p = 1
    this%n = n
    allocate(this%arr(n))
    this%arr = 0
    do while (lshift(p,1) <= n)
      p = lshift(p,1)
    end do
    this%p = p
  end
  subroutine release_bit(this)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    if (associated(this%arr)) deallocate(this%arr)
  end
  subroutine get_addition(this,i,v)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, intent(in) :: v
    integer :: x
    x = i
    do while (x <= this%n)
      this%arr(x) = this%arr(x)+v
      x = x+and(x,-x)
    end do
  end
  function get_summation(this,i) result(s)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer :: x
    integer :: s
    s = -1
    if (i > this%n) return
    s = 0
    x = i
    do while (x > 0)
      s = s+this%arr(x)
      x = x-and(x,-x)
    end do
  end
  function get_partial_summation(this,l,r) result(s)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: l, r
    integer :: i, j
    integer :: s
    s = -1
    if (l > r) return
    s = 0
    i = l-1
    j = r
    do while (j > i)
      s = s+this%arr(j)
      j = j-and(j,-j)
    end do
    do while (i > j)
      s = s-this%arr(i)
      i = i-and(i,-i)
    end do
  end
  function get_value(this,i) result(v)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer :: x
    integer :: v
    v = get_partial_summation(this,i,i)
  end
  function get_lower_bound(this,v) result(x)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: v
    integer :: x, k
    integer :: w
    x = 0
    if (v <= 0) return
    k = this%p
    w = v
    do while (k > 0)
      if (x+k <= this%n .and. this%arr(x+k) < w) then
        w = w-this%arr(x+k)
        x = x+k
      end if
      k = rshift(k,1)
    end do
    x = x+1
  end
  subroutine get_updated(this,i,v)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, intent(in) :: v
    integer :: x
    x = i
    do while (x <= this%n)
      if (this%arr(x) < v) this%arr(x) = v
      x = x+and(x,-x)
    end do
  end
  function get_maximum(this,i) result(m)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer :: x, m
    x = i
    m = 0
    do while (x > 0)
      m = max(m,this%arr(x))
      x = x-and(x,-x)
    end do
  end
  function len_of_lis(a) result(m)
    integer, intent(in) :: a(:)
    type(t_fenwick_tree) :: bit
    integer :: m, n, i, t
    n = size(a)
    call init_bit(bit,n)
    m = 0
    do i = 1, n
      t = get_maximum(bit,a(i)-1)+1
      m = max(m,t)
      call get_updated(bit,a(i),t)
    end do
  end
  function inv_num(a) result(m)
    integer, intent(in) :: a(:)
    type(t_fenwick_tree) :: bit
    integer :: m, n, i, t
    n = size(a)
    call init_bit(bit,n)
    m = 0
    do i = 1, n
      call get_addition(bit,a(i),1)
      m = m+i-get_summation(bit,a(i))
    end do
  end
end module mod_fenwick_tree
program swap_and_flip
  use mod_fenwick_tree
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: inf = 1e9
  integer :: n, a(18) = 0, b(18) = 0, i, k, u, d
  integer :: c(18,2) = 0, x = inf
  read(*,*) n
  read(*,*) a(1:n)
  read(*,*) b(1:n)
  u = lshift(1,n)-1
  do k = 0, u
    d = 0
    do i = 1, n
      if (btest(k,i-1)) then
        c(i,1) = b(i)
        d = d+1
      else
        c(i,1) = a(i)
      end if
      c(i,2) = i
    end do
    if (mod(d,2) == 1) goto 100
    call merge_sort(c(1:n,1:2),1)
    do i = 1, n
      if (modulo(i-c(i,2),2) == 0 .eqv. btest(k,c(i,2)-1)) goto 100
    end do
    x = min(x,inv_num(c(1:n,2)))
100 end do
  if (x == inf) x = -1
  write(*,'(i0)') x
contains
  subroutine merge_sort(a,k)
    integer, intent(inout) :: a(:,:)
    integer, intent(in) :: k
    integer :: n, m, l, i, u
    n = size(a,1)
    m = n
    l = 1
    do while (m > 1)
      do i = 1, m/2
        u = min(2*i*l,n)
        call merger(a(2*(i-1)*l+1:(2*i-1)*l,:),a((2*i-1)*l+1:u,:),k)
      end do
      l = 2*l
      m = (m+1)/2
    end do
  end
  subroutine merger(a1,a2,k)
    integer, intent(inout) :: a1(:,:), a2(:,:)
    integer, intent(in) :: k
    integer :: a(size(a1,1)+size(a2,1),size(a1,2))
    integer :: i1, i2, n1, n2
    i1 = 1
    i2 = 1
    n1 = size(a1,1)
    n2 = size(a2,1)
    do while (i1 <= n1 .and. i2 <= n2)
      if (a1(i1,k) <= a2(i2,k)) then
        a(i1+i2-1,:) = a1(i1,:)
        i1 = i1+1
      else
        a(i1+i2-1,:) = a2(i2,:)
        i2 = i2+1
       end if
    end do
    if (i1 <= n1) then
      a(i1+i2-1:n1+n2,:) = a1(i1:n1,:)
    else
      a(i1+i2-1:n1+n2,:) = a2(i2:n2,:)
    end if
    a1 = a(1:n1,:)
    a2 = a(n1+1:n1+n2,:)
  end
end program swap_and_flip

    procedure :: release => release_bit
    procedure :: add => get_addition
    procedure :: sum => get_summation

  subroutine init_bit(this,n)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    integer :: p

      p = lshift(p,1)
    end do

  end

    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, intent(in) :: v
    integer :: x
    x = i
    do while (x <= this%n)
      this%arr(x) = this%arr(x)+v
      x = x+and(x,-x)
    end do
  end
  function get_summation(this,i) result(s)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer :: x
    integer :: s
    s = -1
    if (i > this%n) return
    s = 0
    x = i
    do while (x > 0)
      s = s+this%arr(x)
      x = x-and(x,-x)
    end do
  end
  function get_partial_summation(this,l,r) result(s)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: l, r
    integer :: i, j
    integer :: s
    s = -1
    if (l > r) return
    s = 0
    i = l-1
    j = r
    do while (j > i)
      s = s+this%arr(j)
      j = j-and(j,-j)
    end do
    do while (i > j)
      s = s-this%arr(i)
      i = i-and(i,-i)
    end do
  end

    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this

    integer, intent(in) :: v
    integer :: x, k

    w = v
    do while (k > 0)

        w = w-this%arr(x+k)
        x = x+k
      end if
      k = rshift(k,1)
    end do
    x = x+1

    integer, intent(in) :: i

    integer, intent(in) :: i

    m = 0
    do i = 1, n

local mmi = math.min
local inf = 1000000007
local n = io.read("*n")
local a, b = {}, {}
for i = 1, n do
  a[i] = io.read("*n")
end
for i = 1, n do
  b[i] = io.read("*n")
end
local alltask = {}
local tot = 1
local stagetask = {}

local function heldkarp_prepare()
  for i = 1, n do
    tot = tot * 2
    alltask[i] = {}
    stagetask[i] = {}
  end
  for i = 1, n do
    for j = 1, tot - 1 do
      -- set inf value
      alltask[i][j] = 1000000007
    end
  end
  for i = 1, tot - 1 do
    local ti = i
    local cnt = 0
    for j = 1, n do
      if ti % 2 == 1 then
        cnt = cnt + 1
        ti = ti - 1
      end
      ti = ti / 2
    end
    table.insert(stagetask[cnt], i)
  end
  -- set first state
  local tmp = 1
  for i = 1, n do
    alltask[i][tmp] = i - 1
    tmp = tmp * 2
  end
end

local function heldkarp_doall()
  for stage = 1, n - 1 do
    local stlen = #stagetask[stage]
    for i_stagetask = 1, stlen do
      local used = stagetask[stage][i_stagetask]
      local t_used = used
      for i = 1, n do
        if t_used % 2 == 1 then
          local curcost = alltask[i][used]
          local v = (i + stage) % 2 == 0 and a[i] or b[i]
          local mul = 1
          local tmp = used
          local remcnt = 0
          for j = 1, n do
            if tmp % 2 == 0 then
              remcnt = remcnt + 1
              local jlen = remcnt - 1
              local nxtv = (j + stage + 1) % 2 == 0 and a[j] or b[j]
              if v <= nxtv then
                alltask[j][used + mul] = mmi(alltask[j][used + mul], jlen + curcost)
              end
            else
              tmp = tmp - 1
            end
            tmp = tmp / 2
            mul = mul * 2
          end
          t_used = t_used - 1
        end
        t_used = t_used / 2
      end
    end
  end
end

local function heldkarp_getresult()
  local ret = 1000000007
  for i = 1, n do
    ret = mmi(ret, alltask[i][tot - 1])
  end
  return ret
end
heldkarp_prepare()
heldkarp_doall()
local ans = heldkarp_getresult()
print(ans == 1000000007 and -1 or ans)

  bs_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
  let !totSort = VU.create $ do
        vec <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.indexed $ as_ VU.++ bs_
        vait_sortBy (compare `on` swap) vec; return vec
      lenAs = VU.length as_
      !(!as,!bs,!numVals) = runST $ do
        as <- VUM.new lenAs
        bs <- VUM.new (VU.length bs_)
        if VU.null totSort then return (VU.empty,VU.empty,0) else do
          (!kLast,!_) <- VU.foldM'
            (\ (!kprev,!vprev) (!i,!v) -> do
                let !k = if vprev == v then kprev else kprev+1
                if i < lenAs
                  then VUM.unsafeWrite as i k
                  else VUM.unsafeWrite bs (i-lenAs) k
                return (k,v))
            (0,snd $ VU.head totSort) totSort
          liftA2 (,,kLast+1) (VU.unsafeFreeze as) (VU.unsafeFreeze bs)
  -- print as
  -- print bs
  print $ fromMaybe (-1) $ query n numVals as bs
  return ()

{-# INLINE query #-}
query :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Maybe Int
query n numVals as bs = ret $ go 0 0
  where
    calc !inSeq !maxSeq = VU.ifoldr
      (\ !bef !i cont !minRes ->
         let !ai = as `VU.unsafeIndex` i; !bi = bs `VU.unsafeIndex` i
             v = if xor i cnt .&. 1 /= 0 then bi else ai
         in if | ai < maxSeq && bi < maxSeq -> 254
               | v >= maxSeq
                 -> cont $! min minRes $! bef + go (setBit inSeq i) v
               | otherwise -> cont minRes)
      id (enumUnsetBits n inSeq) 254
      where !cnt = popCount inSeq
    go !inSeq !maxSeq = BSU.accursedUnutterablePerformIO $ do
      !prevVal <- toInt <$> VUM.unsafeRead dp i
      if prevVal < 255
        then return prevVal
        else seq res $ VUM.unsafeWrite dp i (toW8 res) >> return res
      where res = calc inSeq maxSeq; !i = ident maxSeq inSeq
    {-# NOINLINE dp #-}
    !dp = unsafePerformIO $ do
      dp <- VUM.replicate (numVals * bit n) (255 :: Word8)
      VU.forM_ (VU.generate numVals id)
        $ \ !i -> VUM.unsafeWrite dp (ident i bMask) 0
      return dp
    {-# INLINE ident #-}
    ident !maxSeq !inSeq = maxSeq * rowLen + inSeq
    !rowLen = bit n
    !bMask = bit n - 1
    ret x | x >= 254 = Nothing
          | otherwise = Just x

enumUnsetBits :: forall b. FiniteBits b => Int -> b -> VU.Vector Int
{-# INLINE enumUnsetBits #-}
enumUnsetBits !n !x = VU.filter (not . testBit x) $ VU.generate n id

enumSetBits :: forall b. FiniteBits b => Int -> b -> VU.Vector Int
{-# INLINE enumSetBits #-}
enumSetBits !n !x = VU.filter (testBit x) $ VU.generate n id

#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
    len = u - l
    loop k | k < 0 = return ()
    loop k = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
      vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

query :: VU.Vector (Int,Int) -> Maybe Int
query vec = (\res -> if res >= maxBound then Nothing else Just res)
  $ VU.minimum
  $ (`VU.map` VU.filter ((==nOdd) . popCount) (VU.generate (bit n) id))
  $ \ !bitMask ->
  let !(!ods,!evs) = VU.unstablePartition (\(!_,!i) -> 1.&.i /= 0)
        $ VU.imap (\ !i (!x,!y) -> let !b = testBit bitMask i
                    in (if xor b $ odd i then y else x,
                        (if b then (1.|.) else id) $ shiftL i 1)) vec
      !(!odvs,!odis) = VU.unzip $ VU.create $ do
        v <- VU.unsafeThaw ods
        vait_sort v; return v
      !(!evvs,!evis) = VU.unzip $ VU.create $ do
        v <- VU.unsafeThaw evs
        vait_sort v; return v
      !vs = VU.generate n $ \ !i ->
        VU.unsafeIndex (if odd i then odvs else evvs) (shiftR i 1)
      resOd = VU.sum $ (`VU.imap` odis) $ \ !i !iOrig ->
        VU.length $ VU.filter (< iOrig)
        $ VU.drop (i+1) odis VU.++ VU.drop (i+1) evis
      resEv = VU.sum $ (`VU.imap` evis) $ \ !i !iOrig ->
        VU.length $ VU.filter (< iOrig)
        $ VU.drop i odis VU.++ VU.drop (i+1) evis
  in if VU.or $ vZipTailWith (>) vs then maxBound
     else resOd + resEv
  where
    n = VU.length vec
    nOdd = n `div` 2

{-# INLINE_FUSED zipTailWithM_stream #-}
zipTailWithM_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m b
zipTailWithM_stream f (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step2 (Nothing, s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step2 #-}
    step2 (Nothing, s0) = (<$> step s0) $ \res -> case res of
      VFSM.Yield a1 s1 -> VFSM.Skip (Just a1, s1)
      VFSM.Skip     s1 -> VFSM.Skip (Nothing, s1)
      VFSM.Done        -> VFSM.Done
    step2 (Just a0, s0) = step s0 >>= \res -> case res of
      VFSM.Yield a1 s1 -> (`VFSM.Yield` (Just a1, s1)) <$> f a0 a1
      VFSM.Skip     s1 -> return $ VFSM.Skip (Just a0, s1)
      VFSM.Done        -> return $ VFSM.Done

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_stream #-}
zipTailWith_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m b
zipTailWith_stream f = zipTailWithM_stream (\a0 a1 -> return (f a0 a1))

{-# INLINE zipTail_stream #-}
zipTail_stream :: Monad m => VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m (a,a)
zipTail_stream = zipTailWith_stream (,)

  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWithM_mbundle f VFBM.Bundle{VFBM.sElems = s, VFBM.sSize = n}
  = VFBM.fromStream (zipTailWithM_stream f s) (VFBS.clampedSubtract n 1)

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_mbundle #-}
zipTailWith_mbundle :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWith_mbundle f = zipTailWithM_mbundle (\a0 a1 -> return $ f a0 a1)

{-# INLINE zipTail_mbundle #-}
zipTail_mbundle :: Monad m => VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v (a,a)
zipTail_mbundle = zipTailWith_mbundle (,)

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_bundle #-}
zipTailWith_bundle :: (a -> a -> b) -> VFB.Bundle v a -> VFB.Bundle v b
zipTailWith_bundle = zipTailWith_mbundle

{-# INLINE zipTail_bundle #-}
zipTail_bundle :: VFB.Bundle v a -> VFB.Bundle v (a,a)
zipTail_bundle = zipTail_mbundle

{-# INLINE vZipTailWith #-}
vZipTailWith :: (VG.Vector v a, VG.Vector v b) => (a -> a -> b) -> v a -> v b
vZipTailWith f = VG.unstream . zipTailWith_bundle f . VG.stream

{-# INLINE vZipTail #-}
vZipTail :: (VG.Vector v a, VG.Vector v (a,a)) => v a -> v (a,a)
vZipTail = vZipTailWith (,)

#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
    len = u - l
    loop k | k < 0 = return ()
    loop k = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
      vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

-- | A type of comparisons between two values of a given type.
type Comparison e = e -> e -> Ordering

vac_midPoint :: Int -> Int -> Int
vac_midPoint a b =
  fromIntegral $ (toWord a + toWord b) `div` 2
  where
    toWord :: Int -> Word
    toWord = fromIntegral
{-# INLINE vac_midPoint #-}

#undef vec_writes3
#undef vec_writes4

#undef FILTER

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix

  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

streamMapFoldl :: (Functor m) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine
  as_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
  bs_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
  let !totSort = VU.create $ do
        vec <- VU.thaw $ VU.indexed $ as_ VU.++ bs_
        vait_sortBy (compare `on` swap) vec; return vec
      lenAs = VU.length as_
      !(!as,!bs,!numVals) = runST $ do
        as <- VU.thaw as_
        bs <- VU.thaw bs_
        if VU.null totSort then return (VU.empty,VU.empty,0) else do
          (!kLast,!_) <- VU.foldM'
            (\ (!kprev,!vprev) (!i,!v) -> do
                let !k = if vprev == v then kprev else kprev+1
                if i < lenAs
                  then VUM.unsafeWrite as i k
                  else VUM.unsafeWrite bs (i-lenAs) k
                return (k,v))
            (0,snd $ VU.head totSort) totSort
          liftA2 (,,kLast+1) (VU.unsafeFreeze as) (VU.unsafeFreeze bs)
  -- print as
  -- print bs
  print $ fromMaybe (-1) $ query n numVals as bs
  return ()

query :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Maybe Int
query n numVals as bs = ret $ go 0 0
  where
    calc !inSeq !maxSeq
      | VU.any (\ !i -> VU.unsafeIndex as i > maxSeq
                 && VU.unsafeIndex bs i > maxSeq) outSeq = 254
      | otherwise = VU.minimum $ VU.cons 254
        $ VU.map (\(!bef,!i,!v) -> bef + go (setBit inSeq i) v)
        $ VU.filter (\(!_,!_,!v) -> v>=maxSeq)
        $ VU.imap (\ !bef !i -> if xor i cnt .&. 1 /= 0
                   then (bef,i,) $! VU.unsafeIndex bs i
                   else (bef,i,) $! VU.unsafeIndex as i)
        outSeq
      where
        {-# INLINE CONLIKE outSeq #-}
        outSeq = enumSetBits $ bMask .&. complement inSeq
        !cnt = popCount inSeq
    go !inSeq !maxSeq = BSU.accursedUnutterablePerformIO $ do
      prevVal <- toInt <$> VUM.unsafeRead (dp `V.unsafeIndex` maxSeq) inSeq
      if prevVal < 255 then return prevVal else do
        VUM.unsafeWrite (dp `V.unsafeIndex` maxSeq) inSeq $! toW8 res
        return res
      where res = calc inSeq maxSeq
    {-# NOINLINE dp #-}
    !dp = unsafePerformIO $ do
      dpLin <- VUM.replicate (numVals * bit n) (255 :: Word8)
      let !dp = mLinToMat numVals (bit n) dpLin
      V.forM_ dp $ \ !vec -> VUM.unsafeWrite vec bMask 0
      return dp
    !bMask = bit n - 1
    ret x | x >= 254 = Nothing
          | otherwise = Just x

enumSetBits :: forall b. FiniteBits b => b -> VU.Vector Int
{-# INLINE enumSetBits #-}
enumSetBits = VU.unfoldrN (finiteBitSize (undefined :: b)) $ \ !b ->
  let !i = countTrailingZeros b
  in if b == zeroBits then Nothing else Just (i,clearBit b i)

#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
    len = u - l
    loop k | k < 0 = return ()
    loop k = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
      vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

v2BSpcSepLnWith, v2BSpcSepWith, v2BConcatWith, v2BLinesWith ::
  (VG.Vector v a)
  => (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLnWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith $ BS.singleton '\n'
IL(v2BSpcSepWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith BS.empty
IL(v2BConcatWith) showFct = VG.foldr ((<>) . showFct) mempty
IL(v2BLinesWith) showFct
  = VG.foldr (\ a -> (showFct a <>) . (BSB.char7 '\n' <>)) mempty

  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostfWith) = vecToBuilder BS.empty $ BS.singleton ' '

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

IL(vMapFoldl) :: (VG.Vector v b, VG.Vector v c) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> v b -> v c
vMapFoldl f a
  = VG.unstream . VFB.inplace (streamMapFoldl f a) id . VG.stream

streamMapFoldl :: (Functor m) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \case
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

  wrA arr i fai
  return (ai,fai)

  let !fai = f ai
  wrA arr i fai

  ai <- rdA arr i
  wrA arr i =<< rdA arr j

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine
  as <- getVecULn n rIntS
  bs <- getVecULn n rIntS
  print $ fromMaybe (-1) $ query $ VU.zip as bs
  return ()

query :: VU.Vector (Int,Int) -> Maybe Int
query vec = (\res -> if res >= maxBound then Nothing else Just res)
  $ VU.minimum
  $ (`VU.map` VU.filter ((==nOdd) . popCount) (VU.generate (bit n) id))
  $ \ !bitMask ->
  let !(!ods,!evs) = VU.unstablePartition (\(!_,!i) -> 1.&.i /= 0)
        $ VU.imap (\ !i (!x,!y) -> let !b = testBit bitMask i
                    in (if xor b $ odd i then y else x,
                        (if b then (1.|.) else id) $ shiftL i 1)) vec
      !(!odvs,!odis) = VU.unzip $ VU.create $ do
        v <- VU.unsafeThaw ods
        vais_sort v; return v
      !(!evvs,!evis) = VU.unzip $ VU.create $ do
        v <- VU.unsafeThaw evs
        vais_sort v; return v
      !vs = VU.generate n $ \ !i ->
        VU.unsafeIndex (if odd i then odvs else evvs) (shiftR i 1)
      resOd = VU.sum $ (`VU.imap` odis) $ \ !i !iOrig ->
        VU.length $ VU.filter (< iOrig)
        $ VU.drop (i+1) odis VU.++ VU.drop (i+1) evis
      resEv = VU.sum $ (`VU.imap` evis) $ \ !i !iOrig ->
        VU.length $ VU.filter (< iOrig)
        $ VU.drop i odis VU.++ VU.drop (i+1) evis
  in if VU.or $ vZipTailWith (>) vs then maxBound
     else resOd + resEv
  where
    n = VU.length vec
    nOdd = n `div` 2

{-# INLINE_FUSED zipTailWithM_stream #-}
zipTailWithM_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m b
zipTailWithM_stream f (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step2 (Nothing, s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step2 #-}
    step2 (Nothing, s0) = (<$> step s0) $ \res -> case res of
      VFSM.Yield a1 s1 -> VFSM.Skip (Just a1, s1)
      VFSM.Skip     s1 -> VFSM.Skip (Nothing, s1)
      VFSM.Done        -> VFSM.Done
    step2 (Just a0, s0) = step s0 >>= \res -> case res of
      VFSM.Yield a1 s1 -> (`VFSM.Yield` (Just a1, s1)) <$> f a0 a1
      VFSM.Skip     s1 -> return $ VFSM.Skip (Just a0, s1)
      VFSM.Done        -> return $ VFSM.Done

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_stream #-}
zipTailWith_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m b
zipTailWith_stream f = zipTailWithM_stream (\a0 a1 -> return (f a0 a1))

{-# INLINE zipTail_stream #-}
zipTail_stream :: Monad m => VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m (a,a)
zipTail_stream = zipTailWith_stream (,)

{-# INLINE_FUSED zipTailWithM_mbundle #-}
zipTailWithM_mbundle :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWithM_mbundle f VFBM.Bundle{VFBM.sElems = s, VFBM.sSize = n}
  = VFBM.fromStream (zipTailWithM_stream f s) (VFBS.clampedSubtract n 1)

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_mbundle #-}
zipTailWith_mbundle :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWith_mbundle f = zipTailWithM_mbundle (\a0 a1 -> return $ f a0 a1)

{-# INLINE zipTail_mbundle #-}
zipTail_mbundle :: Monad m => VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v (a,a)
zipTail_mbundle = zipTailWith_mbundle (,)

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_bundle #-}
zipTailWith_bundle :: (a -> a -> b) -> VFB.Bundle v a -> VFB.Bundle v b
zipTailWith_bundle = zipTailWith_mbundle

{-# INLINE zipTail_bundle #-}
zipTail_bundle :: VFB.Bundle v a -> VFB.Bundle v (a,a)
zipTail_bundle = zipTail_mbundle

{-# INLINE vZipTailWith #-}
vZipTailWith :: (VG.Vector v a, VG.Vector v b) => (a -> a -> b) -> v a -> v b
vZipTailWith f = VG.unstream . zipTailWith_bundle f . VG.stream

{-# INLINE vZipTail #-}
vZipTail :: (VG.Vector v a, VG.Vector v (a,a)) => v a -> v (a,a)
vZipTail = vZipTailWith (,)

#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise


-- | Sorts an entire array using the default comparison for the type
vais_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) =>
  v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vais_sort = vais_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vais_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a given comparison
vais_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vais_sortBy cmp a = vais_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vais_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of an array delimited by [l,u)
vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of the array delimited by [l,u) under the assumption
-- that [l,m) is already sorted.
vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

-- Given a sorted array in [l,u), inserts val into its proper position,
-- yielding a sorted [l,u]
vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

-- | Sorts the elements at the positions 'off' and 'off + 1' in the given
-- array using the comparison.
vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}


-- | Sorts the elements at the two given indices using the comparison. This
-- is essentially a compare-and-swap, although the first index is assumed to
-- be the 'lower' of the two.
vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the three elements starting at the given offset in the array.
vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the three given indices. The indices are assumed
-- to be given from lowest to highest, so if 'l < m < u' then
-- 'vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a m l u' essentially sorts the median of three into the
-- lowest position in the array.
vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the four elements beginning at the offset.
vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

-- The horror...

-- | Sorts the elements at the four given indices. Like the 2 and 3 element
-- versions, this assumes that the indices are given in increasing order, so
-- it can be used to sort medians into particular positions and so on.
vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

-- | A type of comparisons between two values of a given type.
type Comparison e = e -> e -> Ordering

vac_midPoint :: Int -> Int -> Int
vac_midPoint a b =
  toInt $ (toWord a + toWord b) `div` 2
  where
    toWord :: Int -> Word
    toWord = fromIntegral

    toInt :: Word -> Int
    toInt = fromIntegral
{-# INLINE vac_midPoint #-}

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

v2BSpcSepLn, v2BSpcSep, v2BConcat, v2BLines ::
  (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLn) = v2BSpcSepLnWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BSpcSep) = v2BSpcSepWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BConcat) = v2BConcatWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BLines) = v2BLinesWith showAsBuilder


v2BSpcSepLnWith, v2BSpcSepWith, v2BConcatWith, v2BLinesWith ::
  (VG.Vector v a)
  => (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLnWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith $ BS.singleton '\n'
IL(v2BSpcSepWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith BS.empty
IL(v2BConcatWith) showFct = VG.foldr ((<>) . showFct) mempty
IL(v2BLinesWith) showFct
  = VG.foldr (\ a -> (showFct a <>) . (BSB.char7 '\n' <>)) mempty


v2BSpcSepPostf :: (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostf) = (`v2BSpcSepPostfWith` showAsBuilder)

v2BSpcSepPostfWith :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostfWith) = vecToBuilder BS.empty $ BS.singleton ' '

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

IL(evalVals) :: [a] -> [a]
evalVals xs = build $ \c n -> foldr (c $!) n xs
IL(forceVals) :: (NFData a) => [a] -> [a]

IL(linToMat) :: (VG.Vector v a) => Int -> Int -> v a -> V.Vector (v a)

IL(unsafeAddrToSVec) :: Int -> Addr# -> VS.Vector Word8

IL(vEvalElemsId) :: (VG.Vector v a) => v a -> v a
vEvalElemsId = vMapFoldl (\() !x -> (x,())) ()

IL(vEvalElems) :: (VG.Vector v a) => v a -> ()
vEvalElems = VG.foldl' (\() !x -> ()) () 

IL(vMapFoldl) :: (VG.Vector v b, VG.Vector v c) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> v b -> v c
vMapFoldl f a
  = VG.unstream . VFB.inplace (streamMapFoldl f a) id . VG.stream

streamMapFoldl :: (Functor m) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

IL(svecToBS) :: VS.Vector Word8 -> BS.ByteString
svecToBS vec = BSU.fromForeignPtr ptr 0 len
  where (ptr, len) = VS.unsafeToForeignPtr0 vec


unlessM, whenM :: (Monad m) => m Bool -> m () -> m ()
IL(whenM) = (. flip when) . (>>=)
IL(unlessM) = (. flip unless) . (>>=)

IL(wrA) = A.writeArray
IL(rdA) = A.readArray
IL(mdA) = \arr f !i -> do
  ai <- rdA arr i
  let fai = f ai 
  wrA arr i fai
  return (ai,fai)
{-# INLINE mdA' #-}
mdA' = \arr f !i -> do
  !ai <- rdA arr i
  let !fai = f ai
  wrA arr i fai
  return (ai,fai)
IL(swapA) = \arr !i !j -> do
  ai <- rdA arr i
  wrA arr i =<< rdA arr j
  wrA arr j ai

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine
  as_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
  bs_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
  let !totSort = VU.create $ do
        vec <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.indexed $ as_ VU.++ bs_
        vait_sortBy (compare `on` swap) vec; return vec
      lenAs = VU.length as_
      !(!as,!bs,!numVals) = runST $ do
        as <- VUM.new lenAs
        bs <- VUM.new (VU.length bs_)
        if VU.null totSort then return (VU.empty,VU.empty,0) else do
          (!kLast,!_) <- VU.foldM'
            (\ (!kprev,!vprev) (!i,!v) -> do
                let !k = if vprev == v then kprev else kprev+1
                if i < lenAs
                  then VUM.unsafeWrite as i k
                  else VUM.unsafeWrite bs (i-lenAs) k
                return (k,v))
            (0,snd $ VU.head totSort) totSort
          liftA2 (,,kLast+1) (VU.unsafeFreeze as) (VU.unsafeFreeze bs)
  -- print as
  -- print bs
  print $ fromMaybe (-1) $ query n numVals as bs
  return ()

{-# INLINE query #-}
query :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Maybe Int
query n numVals as bs = ret $ go 0 0
  where
    calc !inSeq !maxSeq
      | VU.any (\ !i -> VU.unsafeIndex as i < maxSeq
                 && VU.unsafeIndex bs i < maxSeq)
        $ enumSetBits n $ bMask .&. complement inSeq = 254
      | otherwise = VU.minimum $ VU.cons 254
        $ VU.map (\(!bef,!i,!v) -> bef + go (setBit inSeq i) v)
        $ VU.filter (\(!_,!_,!v) -> v>=maxSeq)
        $ VU.imap (\ !bef !i -> if xor i cnt .&. 1 /= 0
                   then (bef,i,) $! VU.unsafeIndex bs i
                   else (bef,i,) $! VU.unsafeIndex as i)
        $ enumSetBits n $ bMask .&. complement inSeq
      where
        !cnt = popCount inSeq
    go !inSeq !maxSeq = BSU.accursedUnutterablePerformIO $ do
      prevVal <- toInt <$> VUM.unsafeRead (dp `V.unsafeIndex` maxSeq) inSeq
      if prevVal < 255 then return prevVal else do
        VUM.unsafeWrite (dp `V.unsafeIndex` maxSeq) inSeq $! toW8 res
        return res
      where res = calc inSeq maxSeq
    {-# NOINLINE dp #-}
    !dp = unsafePerformIO $ do
      dpLin <- VUM.replicate (numVals * bit n) (255 :: Word8)
      let !dp = mLinToMat numVals (bit n) dpLin
      V.forM_ dp $ \ !vec -> VUM.unsafeWrite vec bMask 0
      return dp
    !bMask = bit n - 1
    ret x | x >= 254 = Nothing
          | otherwise = Just x

enumSetBits :: forall b. FiniteBits b => Int -> b -> VU.Vector Int
{-# INLINE enumSetBits #-}
{-
enumSetBits = VU.unfoldrN (finiteBitSize (undefined :: b)) $ \ !b ->
  let !i = countTrailingZeros b
  in if b == zeroBits then Nothing else Just (i,clearBit b i)
-}
enumSetBits !n !x = VU.filter (testBit x) $ VU.generate n id
