#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
    len = u - l
    loop k | k < 0 = return ()
    loop k = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
      vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

v2BSpcSepLnWith, v2BSpcSepWith, v2BConcatWith, v2BLinesWith ::
  (VG.Vector v a)
  => (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLnWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith $ BS.singleton '\n'

  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> v b -> v c

streamMapFoldl :: (Functor m) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \case
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine
  as_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
  bs_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
  let !totSort = VU.create $ do
        vec <- VU.thaw $ VU.indexed $ as_ VU.++ bs_
        vait_sortBy (compare `on` swap) vec; return vec
      lenAs = VU.length as_
      !(!as,!bs,!numVals) = runST $ do
        as <- VU.thaw as_
        bs <- VU.thaw bs_
        if VU.null totSort then return (VU.empty,VU.empty,0) else do
          (!kLast,!_) <- VU.foldM'
            (\ (!kprev,!vprev) (!i,!v) -> do
                let !k = if vprev == v then kprev else kprev+1
                if i < lenAs
                  then VUM.unsafeWrite as i k
                  else VUM.unsafeWrite bs (i-lenAs) k
                return (k,v))
            (0,snd $ VU.head totSort) totSort
          liftA2 (,,kLast+1) (VU.unsafeFreeze as) (VU.unsafeFreeze bs)
  -- print as
  -- print bs
  print $ fromMaybe (-1) $ query n numVals as bs
  return ()

query :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Maybe Int
query n numVals as bs = ret $ runST $ do
  dpLin <- VUM.replicate (numVals * bit n) (255::Word8)
  let !dp = mLinToMat numVals (bit n) dpLin
      go !inSeq !maxSeq = do
        prevVal <- toInt <$> VUM.read (dp V.! maxSeq) inSeq
        if prevVal < 255 then return prevVal else do
          !res <- calc inSeq maxSeq
          VUM.unsafeWrite (dp V.! maxSeq) inSeq $ toW8 res
          return res
      calc !inSeq !maxSeq = VU.ifoldr
        (\ !numSmall !i cont !minRes -> do
            let !cnt = popCount inSeq
                ai = as VU.! i; bi = bs VU.! i
            -- unsafeIOToPrim $ print i
            if | ai < maxSeq && bi < maxSeq -> return 254
               | xor i cnt .&. 1 /= 0 && bi >= maxSeq
                 -> cont . min minRes . (+numSmall) =<< go (setBit inSeq i) bi
               | xor i cnt .&. 1 == 0 && ai >= maxSeq
                 -> cont . min minRes . (+numSmall) =<< go (setBit inSeq i) ai
               | otherwise -> cont minRes)
        (return $!)
        (enumSetBits $ bMask .&. complement inSeq) 254
  V.forM_ dp $ \ !vec -> VUM.unsafeWrite vec (bit n - 1) 0
  go 0 0
  where
    !bMask = bit n - 1
    ret x | x >= 254 = Nothing
          | otherwise = Just x

enumSetBits :: forall b. FiniteBits b => b -> VU.Vector Int
{-# INLINE enumSetBits #-}
enumSetBits = VU.unfoldrN (finiteBitSize (undefined :: b)) $ \ !b ->
  let !i = countTrailingZeros b
  in if b == zeroBits then Nothing else Just (i,clearBit b i)

#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
    len = u - l
    loop k | k < 0 = return ()
    loop k = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
      vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)

streamMapFoldl :: (Functor m) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine
  as_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
  bs_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
  let !totSort = VU.create $ do
        vec <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.indexed $ as_ VU.++ bs_
        vait_sortBy (compare `on` swap) vec; return vec
      lenAs = VU.length as_
      !(!as,!bs,!numVals) = runST $ do
        as <- VUM.new lenAs
        bs <- VUM.new (VU.length bs_)
        if VU.null totSort then return (VU.empty,VU.empty,0) else do
          (!kLast,!_) <- VU.foldM'
            (\ (!kprev,!vprev) (!i,!v) -> do
                let !k = if vprev == v then kprev else kprev+1
                if i < lenAs
                  then VUM.unsafeWrite as i k
                  else VUM.unsafeWrite bs (i-lenAs) k
                return (k,v))
            (0,snd $ VU.head totSort) totSort
          liftA2 (,,kLast+1) (VU.unsafeFreeze as) (VU.unsafeFreeze bs)
  -- print as
  -- print bs
  print $ fromMaybe (-1) $ query n numVals as bs
  return ()

{-# INLINE query #-}
query :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Maybe Int
query n numVals as bs = ret $ go 0 0
  where
    calc !inSeq !maxSeq = VU.ifoldr
      (\ !bef !i cont !minRes ->
         let !ai = as `VU.unsafeIndex` i; !bi = bs `VU.unsafeIndex` i
             v = if xor i cnt .&. 1 /= 0 then bi else ai
         in if | ai < maxSeq && bi < maxSeq -> 254
               | v >= maxSeq
                 -> cont $! min minRes $! bef + go (setBit inSeq i) v
               | otherwise -> cont minRes)
      id (enumUnsetBits n inSeq) 254
      where !cnt = popCount inSeq
    go !inSeq !maxSeq = BSU.accursedUnutterablePerformIO $ do
      !prevVal <- toInt <$> VUM.unsafeRead dp i
      if prevVal < 255
        then return prevVal
        else seq res $ VUM.unsafeWrite dp i (toW8 res) >> return res
      where res = calc inSeq maxSeq; !i = ident maxSeq inSeq
    {-# NOINLINE dp #-}
    !dp = unsafePerformIO $ do
      dp <- VUM.replicate (numVals * bit n) (255 :: Word8)
      VU.forM_ (VU.generate numVals id)
        $ \ !i -> VUM.unsafeWrite dp (ident i bMask) 0
      return dp
    {-# INLINE ident #-}
    ident !maxSeq !inSeq = maxSeq * rowLen + inSeq
    !rowLen = bit n
    !bMask = bit n - 1
    ret x | x >= 254 = Nothing
          | otherwise = Just x

enumUnsetBits :: forall b. FiniteBits b => Int -> b -> VU.Vector Int
{-# INLINE enumUnsetBits #-}
enumUnsetBits !n !x = VU.filter (not . testBit x) $ VU.generate n id

enumSetBits :: forall b. FiniteBits b => Int -> b -> VU.Vector Int
{-# INLINE enumSetBits #-}
enumSetBits !n !x = VU.filter (testBit x) $ VU.generate n id

vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
    len = u - l
    loop k | k < 0 = return ()
    loop k = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
      vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

-- | A type of comparisons between two values of a given type.
type Comparison e = e -> e -> Ordering

vac_midPoint :: Int -> Int -> Int
vac_midPoint a b =
  fromIntegral $ (toWord a + toWord b) `div` 2
  where
    toWord :: Int -> Word
    toWord = fromIntegral
{-# INLINE vac_midPoint #-}

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

v2BSpcSepLnWith, v2BSpcSepWith, v2BConcatWith, v2BLinesWith ::
  (VG.Vector v a)
  => (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLnWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith $ BS.singleton '\n'

  = VG.foldr (\ a -> (showFct a <>) . (BSB.char7 '\n' <>)) mempty

  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostfWith) = vecToBuilder BS.empty $ BS.singleton ' '

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine
  as <- getVecULn n rIntS
  bs <- getVecULn n rIntS
  print $ (\x -> if x >= maxBound then -1 else x) $ query
    $ VU.zip as bs
  return ()

query :: VU.Vector (Int,Int) -> Int
query vec = runST $ do
  let n = VU.length vec
  dpLin <- VUM.replicate (bit n * n) (maxBound::Int)
  let !dp = mLinToMat (bit n) n dpLin
  forM_ [0..n-1] $ \ !i ->
    VUM.unsafeWrite (dp `V.unsafeIndex` bit i) i 0
  (`V.imapM_` V.init dp)  $ \ !bMask !vecNow -> do
    let !jNew = popCount bMask
    spit $ "bMask: " ++ show bMask
      ++ " (iNew+1=jNew: " ++ show jNew ++ ")"
    VU.forM_ (enumSetBits bMask) $ \ !i -> do
      !prev <- VUM.unsafeRead vecNow i
      let !vi = (if odd (jNew-i) then fst else snd) $ VU.unsafeIndex vec i
      spit $ " Checking For index: " ++ show i 
        ++ " (vi: " ++ show vi ++ ", dpval: " ++ show prev ++ ")" 
      when (prev < maxBound) $ do
        spit "  Being tested..."
        VU.forM_ (enumSetBits $ (bit n - 1) .&. complement bMask) $ \ !j -> do
          let !vj = (if even (jNew-j) then fst else snd) $ VU.unsafeIndex vec j
              !newMask = setBit bMask j
              !newVal = (prev +) $ popCount $ (bit n - bit j) .&. bMask
          spit $ "   Tested Against: " ++ show j
            ++ " (vj: " ++ show vj ++ ", new mask:" ++ show newMask ++
            ", new dpval: " ++ show newVal ++ ")"
          when (vi <= vj) $ do
            spit "    Writing..."
            VUM.unsafeModify (dp V.! newMask) (min newVal) j
  VU.minimum <$> VU.unsafeFreeze (V.last dp)
  where
    wantToSpit = False
    spit | wantToSpit = unsafeIOToPrim . putStrLn
         | otherwise = const $ return ()

enumSetBits :: forall b. FiniteBits b => b -> VU.Vector Int
{-# INLINE enumSetBits #-}
enumSetBits = VU.unfoldrN (finiteBitSize (undefined :: b)) $ \ !b ->
  let !i = countTrailingZeros b
  in if b == zeroBits then Nothing else Just (i,clearBit b i)

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder

                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine
  as_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
  bs_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
  let !totSort = VU.create $ do
        vec <- VU.thaw $ VU.indexed $ as_ VU.++ bs_
        vait_sortBy (compare `on` swap) vec; return vec
      lenAs = VU.length as_
      !(!as,!bs,!numVals) = runST $ do
        as <- VU.thaw as_
        bs <- VU.thaw bs_
        if VU.null totSort then return (VU.empty,VU.empty,0) else do
          (!kLast,!_) <- VU.foldM'
            (\ (!kprev,!vprev) (!i,!v) -> do
                let !k = if vprev == v then kprev else kprev+1
                if i < lenAs
                  then VUM.unsafeWrite as i k
                  else VUM.unsafeWrite bs (i-lenAs) k
                return (k,v))
            (0,snd $ VU.head totSort) totSort
          liftA2 (,,kLast+1) (VU.unsafeFreeze as) (VU.unsafeFreeze bs)
  -- print as
  -- print bs
  print $ fromMaybe (-1) $ query n numVals as bs
  return ()

query :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Maybe Int
query n numVals as bs = ret $ go 0 0
  where
    calc !inSeq !maxSeq
      | VU.any (\ !i -> VU.unsafeIndex as i < maxSeq
                 && VU.unsafeIndex bs i < maxSeq) outSeq = 254
      | otherwise = VU.minimum $ VU.cons 254
        $ VU.map (\(!bef,!i,!v) -> bef + go (setBit inSeq i) v)
        $ VU.filter (\(!_,!_,!v) -> v>=maxSeq)
        $ VU.imap (\ !bef !i -> if xor i cnt .&. 1 /= 0
                   then (bef,i,) $! VU.unsafeIndex bs i
                   else (bef,i,) $! VU.unsafeIndex as i)
        outSeq
      where
        {-# INLINE CONLIKE outSeq #-}
        outSeq = enumSetBits $ bMask .&. complement inSeq
        !cnt = popCount inSeq
    go !inSeq !maxSeq = BSU.accursedUnutterablePerformIO $ do
      prevVal <- toInt <$> VUM.unsafeRead (dp `V.unsafeIndex` maxSeq) inSeq
      if prevVal < 255 then return prevVal else do
        VUM.unsafeWrite (dp `V.unsafeIndex` maxSeq) inSeq $! toW8 res
        return res
      where res = calc inSeq maxSeq
    {-# NOINLINE dp #-}
    !dp = unsafePerformIO $ do
      dpLin <- VUM.replicate (numVals * bit n) (255 :: Word8)
      let !dp = mLinToMat numVals (bit n) dpLin
      V.forM_ dp $ \ !vec -> VUM.unsafeWrite vec bMask 0
      return dp
    !bMask = bit n - 1
    ret x | x >= 254 = Nothing
          | otherwise = Just x

enumSetBits :: forall b. FiniteBits b => b -> VU.Vector Int
{-# INLINE enumSetBits #-}
enumSetBits = VU.unfoldrN (finiteBitSize (undefined :: b)) $ \ !b ->
  let !i = countTrailingZeros b
  in if b == zeroBits then Nothing else Just (i,clearBit b i)

#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
    len = u - l
    loop k | k < 0 = return ()
    loop k = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
      vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

-- | A type of comparisons between two values of a given type.
type Comparison e = e -> e -> Ordering

vac_midPoint :: Int -> Int -> Int
vac_midPoint a b =
  fromIntegral $ (toWord a + toWord b) `div` 2
  where
    toWord :: Int -> Word
    toWord = fromIntegral
{-# INLINE vac_midPoint #-}

  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

v2BSpcSepLn, v2BSpcSep, v2BConcat, v2BLines ::
  (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => v a -> BSB.Builder

IL(v2BSpcSep) = v2BSpcSepWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BConcat) = v2BConcatWith showAsBuilder
IL(v2BLines) = v2BLinesWith showAsBuilder


v2BSpcSepLnWith, v2BSpcSepWith, v2BConcatWith, v2BLinesWith ::
  (VG.Vector v a)
  => (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepLnWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith $ BS.singleton '\n'
IL(v2BSpcSepWith) = v2BSpcSepPostfWith BS.empty
IL(v2BConcatWith) showFct = VG.foldr ((<>) . showFct) mempty
IL(v2BLinesWith) showFct
  = VG.foldr (\ a -> (showFct a <>) . (BSB.char7 '\n' <>)) mempty


v2BSpcSepPostf :: (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder

v2BSpcSepPostfWith :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
IL(v2BSpcSepPostfWith) = vecToBuilder BS.empty $ BS.singleton ' '

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

streamMapFoldl :: (Functor m) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \case
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine
  as_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
  bs_ <- getVecULn n rIntS
  let !totSort = VU.create $ do
        vec <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.indexed $ as_ VU.++ bs_
        vait_sortBy (compare `on` swap) vec; return vec
      lenAs = VU.length as_
      !(!as,!bs,!numVals) = runST $ do
        as <- VUM.new lenAs
        bs <- VUM.new (VU.length bs_)
        if VU.null totSort then return (VU.empty,VU.empty,0) else do
          (!kLast,!_) <- VU.foldM'
            (\ (!kprev,!vprev) (!i,!v) -> do
                let !k = if vprev == v then kprev else kprev+1
                if i < lenAs
                  then VUM.unsafeWrite as i k
                  else VUM.unsafeWrite bs (i-lenAs) k
                return (k,v))
            (0,snd $ VU.head totSort) totSort
          liftA2 (,,kLast+1) (VU.unsafeFreeze as) (VU.unsafeFreeze bs)
  -- print as
  -- print bs
  print $ fromMaybe (-1) $ query n numVals as bs
  return ()

{-# INLINE query #-}
query :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Maybe Int
query n numVals as bs = ret $ go 0 0 0
  where
    calc !inSeq !pCnt !maxSeq = VU.ifoldr
      (\ !bef !i cont !minRes ->
         let !ai = as `VU.unsafeIndex` i; !bi = bs `VU.unsafeIndex` i
             v = if xor i pCnt .&. 1 /= 0 then bi else ai
         in if | ai < maxSeq && bi < maxSeq -> 254
               | v >= maxSeq
                 -> cont $! min minRes $! bef + go (setBit inSeq i) (pCnt+1) v
               | otherwise -> cont minRes)
      id (enumUnsetBits n inSeq) 254
    go !inSeq !pCnt !maxSeq = BSU.accursedUnutterablePerformIO $ do
      !prevVal <- toInt <$> VUM.unsafeRead dp i
      if prevVal < 255
        then return prevVal
        else seq res $ VUM.unsafeWrite dp i (toW8 res) >> return res
      where res = calc inSeq pCnt maxSeq; !i = ident maxSeq inSeq
    {-# NOINLINE dp #-}
    !dp = unsafePerformIO $ do
      dp <- VUM.replicate (numVals * bit n) (255 :: Word8)
      VU.forM_ (VU.generate numVals id)
        $ \ !i -> VUM.unsafeWrite dp (ident i bMask) 0
      return dp
    {-# INLINE ident #-}
    ident !maxSeq !inSeq = maxSeq * rowLen + inSeq
    !rowLen = bit n
    !bMask = bit n - 1
    ret x | x >= 254 = Nothing
          | otherwise = Just x

enumUnsetBits :: forall b. FiniteBits b => Int -> b -> VU.Vector Int
{-# INLINE enumUnsetBits #-}
enumUnsetBits !n !x = VU.filter (not . testBit x) $ VU.generate n id

enumSetBits :: forall b. FiniteBits b => Int -> b -> VU.Vector Int
{-# INLINE enumSetBits #-}
enumSetBits !n !x = VU.filter (testBit x) $ VU.generate n id
